visual.name: sdmpbiWordCloud
visual.description: SDM WordCloud — advanced word cloud with filtering, cross-filtering selection and significance-based word highlighting against numeric data

ar-SA.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: عمود نصي تصنيفي — صف واحد لكل كلمة/عبارة تُرسم في السحابة
ar-SA.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: يحدد حجم الكلمة (مثل التكرار أو الإشارات أو الدرجة)
ar-SA.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: حجم العينة الكامن وراء القيمة — مطلوب لاختبار الدلالة (في الوضعين)
ar-SA.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: قيمة مرجعية لكل كلمة (مثل الفترة السابقة) — يستخدمها وضع الدلالة «مقابل مقياس المقارنة»
ar-SA.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: مقياس يُرجع رمز لون سداسي عشري (مثل #FF0000) — يتجاوز اللوحة أو التدرج أو لون الدلالة لتلك الكلمة
ar-SA.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: مقاييس إضافية تُعرض فقط في التلميح عند تمرير المؤشر على كلمة
ar-SA.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: كيفية دمج القيمة عندما يظهر نفس نص الكلمة في عدة صفوف (مثلاً بعد توحيد حالة الأحرف)
ar-SA.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: كلمات مفصولة بفواصل، تُستبعد من السحابة
ar-SA.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
ar-SA.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
ar-SA.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
ar-SA.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
ar-SA.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.
ar-SA.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: The search text is a regular expression, matched anywhere in the word, ignoring case. A few useful patterns:
ar-SA.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
ar-SA.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)
ar-SA.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: “a”, then anything, then “z” (. is any character, .* any run of characters)
ar-SA.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
ar-SA.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
ar-SA.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: يضع مرشّح نص مباشر فوق المرئي (على العميل فقط، غير محفوظ)
ar-SA.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: تمدد العرض/الارتفاع المطبق على الأشكال الجاهزة — يُتجاهل مع قناع صورة مخصص
ar-SA.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: إيقاف (افتراضي): تبقى الكلمات أفقية في وضع الشكل — سريع وموثوق. تشغيل: يراعي التخطيط ← الدوران مع اختبارات تصادم مُدوَّرة أبطأ
ar-SA.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: يصغّر الكلمة حتى التخطيط ← أصغر حجم خط قبل التخلي عن وضعها
ar-SA.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: أصغر = توضيع أكثف وأدق، أكبر = أسرع
ar-SA.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: يتوقف التوضيع ويرسم ما أمكن احتواؤه بمجرد تجاوز هذه الميزانية، حتى لا يتجمد المرئي أبداً
ar-SA.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: الكلمات التي يقل أساسها عن هذا الحد لا تُميَّز أبداً، لتجنب نتائج مشوشة على عينات صغيرة
ar-SA.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: تلاشي: يظهر المرئي بالكامل تدريجياً. نمو: تُرسم البيانات ثم تظهر التسميات. تتالي: صيغة متدرجة من النمو، تختلف حسب المخطط.
ar-SA.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: مدة الحركة الرئيسية بالمللي ثانية. لا تُشغَّل أبداً أثناء التصدير.
ar-SA.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: سحابة كلمات متقدمة مع التصفية والتحديد والدلالة
ar-SA.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: المقياس الذي يحدد حجم كل كلمة
ar-SA.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: اختياري — حجم العينة، لازم لتمييز الكلمات الدالة

de-DE.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: Kategoriale Textspalte — eine Zeile pro Wort/Ausdruck, das in der Wolke gezeichnet wird
de-DE.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: Bestimmt die Größe des Wortes (z. B. Häufigkeit, Nennungen, Score)
de-DE.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: Stichprobengröße hinter Wert — für den Signifikanztest erforderlich (beide Modi)
de-DE.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: Referenzwert pro Wort (z. B. Vorperiode) — wird vom Signifikanzmodus „Vs Vergleichsmeasure“ verwendet
de-DE.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: Ein Measure, das einen Farb-Hex-Code zurückgibt (z. B. #FF0000) — überschreibt Palette/Farbverlauf/Signifikanzfarbe für dieses Wort
de-DE.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: Zusätzliche Measures, die nur in der QuickInfo beim Überfahren eines Wortes angezeigt werden
de-DE.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: Wie Wert kombiniert wird, wenn derselbe Worttext in mehreren Zeilen vorkommt (z. B. nach Normalisierung der Groß-/Kleinschreibung)
de-DE.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: Durch Kommas getrennte Wörter, die aus der Wolke ausgeschlossen werden
de-DE.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
de-DE.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
de-DE.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
de-DE.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
de-DE.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.
de-DE.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: The search text is a regular expression, matched anywhere in the word, ignoring case. A few useful patterns:
de-DE.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
de-DE.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)
de-DE.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: “a”, then anything, then “z” (. is any character, .* any run of characters)
de-DE.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
de-DE.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
de-DE.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: Legt einen Live-Textfilter über das Visual (nur clientseitig, nicht gespeichert)
de-DE.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: Breiten-/Höhenstreckung für vordefinierte Formen — bei einer benutzerdefinierten Bildmaske ignoriert
de-DE.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: Aus (Standard): Wörter bleiben im Formmodus horizontal — schnell, robust. Ein: berücksichtigt Layout → Drehung mit langsameren Kollisionsprüfungen für gedrehte Wörter
de-DE.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: Verkleinert ein Wort bis zu Layout → Min. Schriftgröße, bevor die Platzierung aufgegeben wird
de-DE.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: Die Platzierung stoppt und zeichnet, was passt, sobald dieses Budget überschritten ist, damit das Visual nie einfriert
de-DE.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: Wörter mit einer Basis darunter werden nie markiert, um verrauschte Ergebnisse bei kleinen Stichproben zu vermeiden
de-DE.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: Einblenden: das gesamte Visual wird eingeblendet. Wachsen: die Daten werden gezeichnet, danach erscheinen die Beschriftungen. Kaskade: eine gestaffelte Variante von Wachsen, je nach Diagramm.
de-DE.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: Dauer der Hauptanimation in Millisekunden. Wird bei einem Export nie abgespielt.
de-DE.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: Erweiterte Wortwolke mit Filterung, Auswahl und Signifikanz
de-DE.Visual_Landing_Step_Words: die Textspalte, die als Wörter gezeichnet wird
de-DE.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: das Measure, das die Größe jedes Wortes bestimmt
de-DE.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: optional — die Stichprobengröße, nötig zum Hervorheben signifikanter Wörter

en-US.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: Categorical text column — one row per word/phrase to draw in the cloud
en-US.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: Sizes the word (e.g. frequency, mentions, score)
en-US.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: Sample size behind Value — required to test significance (both modes)
en-US.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: Reference value per word (e.g. previous period) — used by the "vs comparison measure" significance mode
en-US.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: A measure returning a color hex code (e.g. #FF0000) — overrides palette/gradient/significance color for that word
en-US.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: Extra measures shown only in the tooltip when hovering a word
en-US.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: How to combine Value when the same word text appears on several rows (e.g. after case normalization)
en-US.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: Comma-separated words excluded from the cloud
en-US.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
en-US.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
en-US.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
en-US.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
en-US.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.
en-US.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: The search text is a regular expression, matched anywhere in the word, ignoring case. A few useful patterns:
en-US.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
en-US.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)
en-US.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: “a”, then anything, then “z” (. is any character, .* any run of characters)
en-US.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
en-US.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
en-US.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: Overlays a live text filter on the visual (client-side only, not persisted)
en-US.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: Width/height stretch applied to preset shapes — ignored for a custom image mask
en-US.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: Off (default): words stay horizontal in shape mode — fast, robust. On: honors Layout → Rotation with slower rotated collision checks
en-US.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: Shrink a word toward Layout → Min font size before giving up on placing it
en-US.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: Smaller = denser/more precise placement, larger = faster
en-US.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: Placement stops and draws whatever fits once this budget is exceeded, so the visual never freezes
en-US.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: Words with a base below this are never flagged, to avoid noisy small-sample results
en-US.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: Fade: the whole visual fades in. Grow: the data is drawn, then the labels fade in. Cascade: a staggered variant of Grow, which depends on the chart.
en-US.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: Duration of the main animation, in milliseconds. Never played during an export.
en-US.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: Advanced word cloud with filtering, selection and significance
en-US.Visual_Landing_Step_Words: the text column to draw as words
en-US.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: the measure that sizes each word
en-US.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: optional — the sample size, needed to highlight significant words

es-ES.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: Columna de texto categórica — una fila por palabra/expresión que dibujar en la nube
es-ES.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: Determina el tamaño de la palabra (p. ej. frecuencia, menciones, puntuación)
es-ES.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: Tamaño de muestra detrás de Valor — necesario para probar la significación (ambos modos)
es-ES.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: Valor de referencia por palabra (p. ej. periodo anterior) — utilizado por el modo de significación «vs medida de comparación»
es-ES.Visual_DataRole_ComparisonBase_Descripti: Tamaño de muestra detrás de Comparación
es-ES.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: Una medida que devuelve un código de color hexadecimal (p. ej. #FF0000) — sustituye la paleta/el degradado/el color de significación de esa palabra
es-ES.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: Medidas adicionales mostradas solo en la información sobre herramientas al pasar el cursor por una palabra
es-ES.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: Cómo combinar Valor cuando el mismo texto aparece en varias filas (p. ej. tras normalizar mayúsculas y minúsculas)
es-ES.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: Palabras separadas por comas, excluidas de la nube
es-ES.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
es-ES.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
es-ES.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
es-ES.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
es-ES.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.
es-ES.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: The search text is a regular expression, matched anywhere in the word, ignoring case. A few useful patterns:
es-ES.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
es-ES.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)
es-ES.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: “a”, then anything, then “z” (. is any character, .* any run of characters)
es-ES.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
es-ES.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
es-ES.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: Superpone un filtro de texto en vivo sobre el objeto visual (solo en cliente, no se guarda)
es-ES.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: Estiramiento ancho/alto aplicado a las formas predefinidas — se ignora con una máscara de imagen personalizada
es-ES.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: Desactivado (predeterminado): las palabras se mantienen horizontales en modo forma — rápido y robusto. Activado: respeta Diseño → Rotación con comprobaciones de colisión rotadas, más lentas
es-ES.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: Reduce una palabra hasta Diseño → Tamaño de fuente mín. antes de renunciar a colocarla
es-ES.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: Menor = colocación más densa/precisa, mayor = más rápido
es-ES.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: La colocación se detiene y dibuja lo que quepa en cuanto se supera este presupuesto, para que el objeto visual nunca se congele
es-ES.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: Las palabras con una base inferior nunca se marcan, para evitar resultados ruidosos con muestras pequeñas
es-ES.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: Fundido: todo el objeto visual aparece gradualmente. Crecimiento: se dibujan los datos y luego aparecen las etiquetas. Cascada: variante escalonada de Crecimiento, propia de cada gráfico.
es-ES.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: Duración de la animación principal, en milisegundos. Nunca se reproduce durante una exportación.
es-ES.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: Nube de palabras avanzada con filtrado, selección y significación
es-ES.Visual_Landing_Step_Words: la columna de texto que dibujar como palabras
es-ES.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: la medida que determina el tamaño de cada palabra
es-ES.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: opcional — el tamaño de muestra, necesario para resaltar las palabras significativas

fr-FR.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: Colonne texte catégorielle — une ligne par mot/expression à dessiner dans le nuage
fr-FR.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: Détermine la taille du mot (ex. fréquence, mentions, score)
fr-FR.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: Taille d'échantillon derrière Valeur — requise pour tester la significativité (les deux modes)
fr-FR.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: Valeur de référence par mot (ex. période précédente) — utilisée par le mode de significativité "vs mesure de comparaison"
fr-FR.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: Mesure retournant un code couleur hexadécimal (ex. #FF0000) — remplace la palette/le dégradé/la couleur de significativité pour ce mot
fr-FR.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: Mesures supplémentaires affichées uniquement dans l'infobulle au survol d'un mot
fr-FR.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: Comment combiner Valeur quand le même texte apparaît sur plusieurs lignes (ex. après normalisation de la casse)
fr-FR.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: Mots séparés par des virgules, exclus du nuage
fr-FR.Visual_Filtering_SearchPosition: Emplacement de la zone de recherche
fr-FR.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: Activé : la zone flotte au-dessus du visuel et apparaît au survol. Désactivé : la zone est toujours visible et occupe sa propre place
fr-FR.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Mettre en évidence : atténue les mots non correspondants. Sélectionner : filtre aussi la page. Filtrer : seuls les mots correspondants sont dessinés. Le texte recherché est une expression régulière
fr-FR.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: les mots correspondants restent visibles, les autres sont atténués.
fr-FR.Visual_Search_Select_Description: comme Mettre en évidence, et les mots correspondants sont sélectionnés, ce qui filtre les autres visuels de la page.
fr-FR.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: seuls les mots correspondants sont dessinés ; le nuage est recalculé.
fr-FR.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: Le texte saisi est une expression régulière, recherchée n’importe où dans le mot, sans tenir compte de la casse. Quelques motifs utiles :
fr-FR.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: l’un ou l’autre (deux noms : séparez-les par |)
fr-FR.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: « color » ou « colour » (? rend la lettre précédente facultative)
fr-FR.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: « a », puis n’importe quoi, puis « z » (. = un caractère quelconque, .* = une suite quelconque)
fr-FR.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: Un motif incomplet, comme une parenthèse non fermée, est recherché comme du texte simple.
fr-FR.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Même graine = même disposition à chaque rechargement. 0 = nouvelle disposition aléatoire à chaque fois
fr-FR.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: Superpose un filtre texte live sur le visuel (client uniquement, non persisté)
fr-FR.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: Étirement largeur/hauteur appliqué aux formes prédéfinies — ignoré pour un masque image personnalisé
fr-FR.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: Désactivé (par défaut) : les mots restent horizontaux en mode forme — rapide, robuste. Activé : respecte Disposition → Rotation avec des tests de collision pivotés, plus lents
fr-FR.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: Rétrécit un mot vers Disposition → Taille de police min. avant d'abandonner son placement
fr-FR.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: Plus petit = placement plus dense/précis, plus grand = plus rapide
fr-FR.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: Le placement s'arrête et dessine ce qui tient dès que ce budget est dépassé, pour que le visuel ne gèle jamais
fr-FR.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: Les mots dont la base est inférieure à ce seuil ne sont jamais signalés, pour éviter des résultats bruités sur petit échantillon
fr-FR.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: Fondu : tout le visuel apparaît en fondu. Croissance : les données se dessinent, puis les étiquettes apparaissent. Cascade : variante décalée de Croissance, propre à chaque graphique.
fr-FR.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: Durée de l'animation principale, en millisecondes. Jamais jouée lors d'un export.
fr-FR.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: Nuage de mots avancé avec filtrage, sélection et significativité
fr-FR.Visual_Landing_Step_Words: la colonne texte à dessiner comme mots
fr-FR.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: la mesure qui détermine la taille de chaque mot
fr-FR.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: optionnel — la taille d'échantillon, nécessaire pour mettre en évidence les mots significatifs

he-IL.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: עמודת טקסט קטגורית — שורה לכל מילה/ביטוי שיצויר בענן
he-IL.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: קובע את גודל המילה (למשל שכיחות, אזכורים, ניקוד)
he-IL.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: גודל המדגם שמאחורי ערך — נדרש לבדיקת מובהקות (בשני המצבים)
he-IL.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: ערך ייחוס לכל מילה (למשל התקופה הקודמת) — בשימוש מצב המובהקות «מול מדידת השוואה»
he-IL.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: מדידה שמחזירה קוד צבע הקסדצימלי (למשל #FF0000) — עוקפת את הפלטה, מעבר הצבעים או צבע המובהקות של אותה מילה
he-IL.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: מדידות נוספות שמוצגות רק בתיאור הכלים בעת ריחוף על מילה
he-IL.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: כיצד לאחד ערך כאשר אותו טקסט מופיע בכמה שורות (למשל לאחר נרמול אותיות רישיות)
he-IL.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
he-IL.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
he-IL.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
he-IL.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
he-IL.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.

he-IL.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
he-IL.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)

he-IL.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
he-IL.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
he-IL.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: מציב מסנן טקסט חי מעל הוויזואל (בצד הלקוח בלבד, אינו נשמר)
he-IL.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: מתיחת רוחב/גובה שמוחלת על צורות מוגדרות מראש — אינה חלה על מסכת תמונה מותאמת
he-IL.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: כבוי (ברירת מחדל): המילים נשארות אופקיות במצב צורה — מהיר ועמיד. דלוק: מתחשב בפריסה ← סיבוב, עם בדיקות התנגשות מסובבות ואיטיות יותר
he-IL.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: מקטין מילה עד פריסה ← גודל גופן מינימלי לפני שמוותרים על מיקומה
he-IL.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: קטן יותר = מיקום צפוף ומדויק יותר, גדול יותר = מהיר יותר
he-IL.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: המיקום נעצר ומצייר את מה שנכנס ברגע שתקציב זה נחרג, כך שהוויזואל לעולם אינו נתקע
he-IL.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: מילים שהבסיס שלהן נמוך מכך לעולם אינן מסומנות, כדי למנוע תוצאות רועשות במדגם קטן
he-IL.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: עמעום: כל הוויזואל מופיע בהדרגה. צמיחה: הנתונים מצוירים ואז מופיעות התוויות. מפל: גרסה מדורגת של צמיחה, בהתאם לתרשים.
he-IL.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: משך ההנפשה הראשית, באלפיות שנייה. לעולם לא מופעלת בעת ייצוא.
he-IL.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: ענן מילים מתקדם עם סינון, בחירה ומובהקות
he-IL.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: המדידה שקובעת את גודל כל מילה
he-IL.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: אופציונלי — גודל המדגם, הנדרש להדגשת מילים מובהקות

it-IT.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: Colonna di testo categoriale — una riga per parola/espressione da disegnare nella nuvola
it-IT.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: Determina la dimensione della parola (es. frequenza, menzioni, punteggio)
it-IT.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: Dimensione del campione dietro Valore — necessaria per testare la significatività (entrambe le modalità)
it-IT.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: Valore di riferimento per parola (es. periodo precedente) — usato dalla modalità di significatività «vs misura di confronto»
it-IT.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: Una misura che restituisce un codice colore esadecimale (es. #FF0000) — sostituisce la palette/la sfumatura/il colore di significatività per quella parola
it-IT.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: Misure aggiuntive mostrate solo nella descrizione comandi al passaggio del mouse su una parola
it-IT.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: Come combinare Valore quando lo stesso testo compare su più righe (es. dopo la normalizzazione di maiuscole/minuscole)
it-IT.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: Parole separate da virgole, escluse dalla nuvola
it-IT.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
it-IT.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
it-IT.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
it-IT.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
it-IT.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.
it-IT.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: The search text is a regular expression, matched anywhere in the word, ignoring case. A few useful patterns:
it-IT.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
it-IT.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)
it-IT.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: “a”, then anything, then “z” (. is any character, .* any run of characters)
it-IT.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
it-IT.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
it-IT.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: Sovrappone un filtro di testo live all'oggetto visivo (solo lato client, non persistito)
it-IT.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: Allungamento larghezza/altezza applicato alle forme predefinite — ignorato con una maschera immagine personalizzata
it-IT.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: Disattivato (predefinito): le parole restano orizzontali in modalità forma — rapido, robusto. Attivato: rispetta Layout → Rotazione con controlli di collisione ruotati, più lenti
it-IT.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: Riduce una parola fino a Layout → Dimensione carattere min. prima di rinunciare a posizionarla
it-IT.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: Più piccolo = posizionamento più denso/preciso, più grande = più veloce
it-IT.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: Il posizionamento si interrompe e disegna ciò che entra appena superato questo budget, così l'oggetto visivo non si blocca mai
it-IT.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: Le parole con una base inferiore non vengono mai segnalate, per evitare risultati rumorosi su campioni piccoli
it-IT.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: Dissolvenza: l'intero oggetto visivo appare in dissolvenza. Crescita: i dati vengono disegnati, poi compaiono le etichette. Cascata: variante sfalsata di Crescita, specifica di ogni grafico.
it-IT.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: Durata dell'animazione principale, in millisecondi. Mai riprodotta durante un'esportazione.
it-IT.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: Nuvola di parole avanzata con filtro, selezione e significatività
it-IT.Visual_Landing_Step_Words: la colonna di testo da disegnare come parole
it-IT.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: la misura che determina la dimensione di ogni parola
it-IT.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: opzionale — la dimensione del campione, necessaria per evidenziare le parole significative

pt-PT.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: Coluna de texto categórica — uma linha por palavra/expressão a desenhar na nuvem
pt-PT.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: Define o tamanho da palavra (p. ex. frequência, menções, pontuação)
pt-PT.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: Tamanho da amostra por trás de Valor — necessário para testar a significância (ambos os modos)
pt-PT.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: Valor de referência por palavra (p. ex. período anterior) — utilizado pelo modo de significância «vs medida de comparação»
pt-PT.Visual_DataRole_ComparisonBase_Descripti: Tamanho da amostra por trás de Comparação
pt-PT.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: Uma medida que devolve um código de cor hexadecimal (p. ex. #FF0000) — substitui a paleta/o gradiente/a cor de significância dessa palavra
pt-PT.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: Medidas adicionais mostradas apenas na descrição ao passar o cursor sobre uma palavra
pt-PT.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: Como combinar Valor quando o mesmo texto aparece em várias linhas (p. ex. após normalizar maiúsculas/minúsculas)
pt-PT.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: Palavras separadas por vírgulas, excluídas da nuvem
pt-PT.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
pt-PT.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
pt-PT.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
pt-PT.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
pt-PT.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.
pt-PT.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: The search text is a regular expression, matched anywhere in the word, ignoring case. A few useful patterns:
pt-PT.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
pt-PT.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)
pt-PT.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: “a”, then anything, then “z” (. is any character, .* any run of characters)
pt-PT.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
pt-PT.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
pt-PT.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: Sobrepõe um filtro de texto em direto ao visual (apenas no cliente, não guardado)
pt-PT.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: Alongamento largura/altura aplicado às formas predefinidas — ignorado numa máscara de imagem personalizada
pt-PT.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: Desativado (predefinição): as palavras mantêm-se horizontais no modo forma — rápido e robusto. Ativado: respeita Disposição → Rotação com testes de colisão rodados, mais lentos
pt-PT.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: Reduz uma palavra até Disposição → Tamanho de letra mín. antes de desistir de a colocar
pt-PT.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: Menor = colocação mais densa/precisa, maior = mais rápido
pt-PT.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: A colocação para e desenha o que couber assim que este orçamento é excedido, para que o visual nunca bloqueie
pt-PT.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: As palavras com uma base inferior nunca são assinaladas, para evitar resultados ruidosos em amostras pequenas
pt-PT.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: Desvanecer: todo o visual aparece gradualmente. Crescer: os dados são desenhados e depois surgem as etiquetas. Cascata: variante escalonada de Crescer, própria de cada gráfico.
pt-PT.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: Duração da animação principal, em milissegundos. Nunca reproduzida durante uma exportação.
pt-PT.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: Nuvem de palavras avançada com filtragem, seleção e significância
pt-PT.Visual_Landing_Step_Words: a coluna de texto a desenhar como palavras
pt-PT.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: a medida que define o tamanho de cada palavra
pt-PT.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: opcional — o tamanho da amostra, necessário para destacar as palavras significativas

ro-RO.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: Coloană de text categorială — un rând pentru fiecare cuvânt/expresie de desenat în nor
ro-RO.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: Determină dimensiunea cuvântului (ex. frecvență, mențiuni, scor)
ro-RO.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: Dimensiunea eșantionului din spatele Valoare — necesară pentru testarea semnificației (ambele moduri)
ro-RO.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: Valoare de referință pentru fiecare cuvânt (ex. perioada anterioară) — folosită de modul de semnificație «vs măsură de comparație»
ro-RO.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: O măsură care returnează un cod de culoare hexazecimal (ex. #FF0000) — înlocuiește paleta/gradientul/culoarea de semnificație pentru acel cuvânt
ro-RO.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: Măsuri suplimentare afișate doar în sugestia vizuală, la trecerea peste un cuvânt
ro-RO.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: Cum se combină Valoare când același text apare pe mai multe rânduri (ex. după normalizarea literelor mari/mici)
ro-RO.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: Cuvinte separate prin virgule, excluse din nor
ro-RO.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
ro-RO.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
ro-RO.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
ro-RO.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
ro-RO.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.
ro-RO.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: The search text is a regular expression, matched anywhere in the word, ignoring case. A few useful patterns:
ro-RO.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
ro-RO.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)
ro-RO.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: “a”, then anything, then “z” (. is any character, .* any run of characters)
ro-RO.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
ro-RO.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
ro-RO.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: Suprapune un filtru de text live pe vizual (doar pe client, nu este salvat)
ro-RO.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: Întindere lățime/înălțime aplicată formelor predefinite — ignorată pentru o mască de imagine personalizată
ro-RO.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: Dezactivat (implicit): cuvintele rămân orizontale în modul formă — rapid, robust. Activat: respectă Aspect → Rotire, cu verificări de coliziune rotite, mai lente
ro-RO.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: Micșorează un cuvânt până la Aspect → Dimensiune font min. înainte de a renunța la plasarea lui
ro-RO.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: Mai mic = plasare mai densă/precisă, mai mare = mai rapid
ro-RO.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: Plasarea se oprește și desenează ce încape de îndată ce acest buget este depășit, astfel încât vizualul să nu se blocheze niciodată
ro-RO.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: Cuvintele cu o bază mai mică nu sunt niciodată evidențiate, pentru a evita rezultate zgomotoase pe eșantioane mici
ro-RO.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: Estompare: întregul vizual apare treptat. Creștere: datele sunt desenate, apoi apar etichetele. Cascadă: variantă eșalonată a Creșterii, specifică fiecărui grafic.
ro-RO.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: Durata animației principale, în milisecunde. Nu este redată niciodată la export.
ro-RO.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: Nor de cuvinte avansat, cu filtrare, selecție și semnificație
ro-RO.Visual_Landing_Step_Words: coloana de text de desenat ca cuvinte
ro-RO.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: măsura care determină dimensiunea fiecărui cuvânt
ro-RO.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: opțional — dimensiunea eșantionului, necesară pentru a evidenția cuvintele semnificative

zh-CN.Visual_DataRole_Words_Description: 分类文本列 — 每行一个要绘制到词云中的词或短语
zh-CN.Visual_DataRole_Value_Description: 决定词语的大小（例如频次、提及次数、得分）
zh-CN.Visual_DataRole_Base_Description: 值背后的样本量 — 显著性检验所必需（两种模式均需）
zh-CN.Visual_DataRole_Comparison_Description: 每个词语的参考值（例如上一期）— 由“与对比度量比较”显著性模式使用
zh-CN.Visual_DataRole_SeriesColor_Description: 返回十六进制颜色代码（例如 #FF0000）的度量 — 会覆盖该词语的调色板/渐变/显著性颜色
zh-CN.Visual_DataRole_Tooltips_Description: 仅在悬停某个词语时显示在工具提示中的附加度量
zh-CN.Visual_Words_DuplicateAggregation_Descri: 当同一词语文本出现在多行时（例如大小写归一化之后），如何合并值
zh-CN.Visual_Filtering_StopWords_Description: 以逗号分隔的词语，将从词云中排除
zh-CN.Visual_Filtering_SearchShowOnHover_Descr: On: the box floats over the visual and appears when hovering it. Off: the box is always visible and takes its own space
zh-CN.Visual_Filtering_SearchBehavior_Descript: Highlight: dims non-matching words. Select: also cross-filters the page. Filter: only matching words are drawn. The search text is a regular expression
zh-CN.Visual_Search_Highlight_Description: matching words stay lit, the others are dimmed.
zh-CN.Visual_Search_Select_Description: same as Highlight, and the matching words are selected, which cross-filters the other visuals of the page.
zh-CN.Visual_Search_Filter_Description: only the matching words are drawn; the cloud is laid out again.
zh-CN.Visual_Search_Regex_Intro: The search text is a regular expression, matched anywhere in the word, ignoring case. A few useful patterns:
zh-CN.Visual_Search_Rule_Or: either word (two names: separate them with |)
zh-CN.Visual_Search_Rule_Optional: “color” or “colour” (? makes the previous letter optional)
zh-CN.Visual_Search_Rule_Any: “a”, then anything, then “z” (. is any character, .* any run of characters)
zh-CN.Visual_Search_Regex_Note: An incomplete pattern, such as an unclosed parenthesis, is searched as plain text.
zh-CN.Visual_Layout_Seed_Description: Same seed = same layout on every reload. 0 = a new random layout each time
zh-CN.Visual_Filtering_ShowLiveSearch_Descript: 在视觉对象上叠加实时文本筛选器（仅客户端，不保存）
zh-CN.Visual_Background_Ellipticity_Descriptio: 应用于预设形状的宽高拉伸 — 使用自定义图像蒙版时忽略
zh-CN.Visual_Background_RespectRotation_Descri: 关闭（默认）：形状模式下词语保持水平 — 快速、稳健。开启：遵循 布局 → 旋转，但旋转后的碰撞检测较慢
zh-CN.Visual_Background_ShrinkToFit_Descriptio: 在放弃放置某个词语之前，先将其缩小到 布局 → 最小字号
zh-CN.Visual_Background_GridSize_Description: 越小 = 放置越密集/精确，越大 = 越快
zh-CN.Visual_Background_AbortThreshold_Descrip: 一旦超出该预算，放置即停止并绘制已放入的内容，确保视觉对象永不卡死
zh-CN.Visual_Significance_MinBase_Description: 基数低于此阈值的词语永不被标记，以避免小样本造成的噪声结果
zh-CN.Visual_Animation_Type_Description: 淡入：整个视觉对象淡入。生长：先绘制数据，再淡入标签。级联：生长的错开变体，因图表而异。
zh-CN.Visual_Animation_Duration_Description: 主动画的持续时间（毫秒）。导出时从不播放。
zh-CN.Visual_Landing_Subtitle: 高级词云，支持筛选、选择和显著性标记
zh-CN.Visual_Landing_Step_Words: 要绘制为词语的文本列
zh-CN.Visual_Landing_Step_Value: 决定每个词语大小的度量
zh-CN.Visual_Landing_Step_Base: 可选 — 样本量，用于突出显示显著的词语

dataRoles.name: words
dataRoles.description: Categorical text column — one row per word/phrase to draw in the cloud

dataRoles.name: value
dataRoles.description: Sizes the word (e.g. frequency, mentions, score)

dataRoles.name: base
dataRoles.description: Sample size behind Value — required to test significance (both modes)

dataRoles.name: comparison
dataRoles.description: Reference value per word (e.g. previous period) — used by the "vs comparison measure" significance mode

dataRoles.name: seriesColor
dataRoles.description: A measure returning a color hex code (e.g. #FF0000) — overrides palette/gradient/significance color for that word

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra measures shown only in the tooltip when hovering a word
